title: GCP VPC Network Module
description: Provisions one or more GCP VPC networks with optional subnets and an opt-in allow-SSH firewall rule. Map key is the VPC name.

vpc_network_config.description: Configuration for a single VPC network.

project.description: Project to create the VPC in. Leave empty to use the provider's default project.

routing_mode.description: Whether dynamic routes learned via Cloud Router propagate regionally or globally.

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit for the network (1300-8896).

auto_create_subnetworks.description: When true, GCP creates a subnet in every region automatically. Keep false to use custom-mode VPCs.

delete_default_routes_on_create.description: When true, delete the default 0.0.0.0/0 routes on VPC creation.

subnets.description: List of subnetworks to create inside this VPC.

allow_ssh.description: When true, create a firewall rule allowing tcp:22 from ssh_source_ranges to instances tagged 'ssh'.

ssh_source_ranges.description: Source CIDR ranges allowed to SSH. Only used when allow_ssh=true. Defaults to ['0.0.0.0/0']; restrict in production.

subnet_config.description: A single subnetwork inside a VPC.

name.description: Subnet name (1-63 chars, lowercase, hyphens OK).

region.description: GCP region for the subnet (e.g. us-central1).

ip_cidr_range.description: Primary CIDR range for the subnet (e.g. 10.10.0.0/20).

private_ip_google_access.description: Allow VMs without external IPs to reach Google APIs over the internal network.

key_spec.label: VPC name
key_spec.description: VPC name: 1-63 chars. Must start with a lowercase letter; allowed chars are lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; must end with a letter or digit.
